versions.changelog:
- Initial release of brand-guidelines-zh.
- Enables fast generation of complete brand guideline documents in Chinese, including logo usage, color system, typography, image style, and brand voice.
- Supports easy one-click creation for both new and existing brands.
- Designed for brand managers, marketing directors, design leads, and creative agencies.
- Helps unify brand image, improve team collaboration, and reduce brand misuse risks.
